tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find local businesses on Loomivo by what they do (e.g. 'dentist') and town. Returns which can be booked, ordered from or asked for a quote online; listed: true means a free listing that takes requests in the customer's words, confirmed by the owner within 24 hours.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Verified facts about one business: description, phone, address, opening hours, services or products with prices, and what customers can do online.

tools.name: get_available_times
tools.description: Free booking start times on a date (YYYY-MM-DD, business's local time) for a business that takes bookings. Send service_id (a service from get_business) so only times where the whole service fits are returned; for restaurants that book tables, send party_size.

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Send a booking (kind 'book', slot 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM', with service_id, or party_size for tables), order (kind 'order': details with what the customer wants in their words, and/or items [{offer_id, qty}]; fulfilment pickup|delivery) or quote request (kind 'quote', details) for the customer. tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Whether the business confirmed a request (by its ref), with a price for quotes.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_businesses" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
